market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$77,160 on Apr 29, 2026. The February 2026 capitulation low was $60,033. Reaching $45K requires another ~25% drop below that floor or ~42% from spot. Historical BTC drawdowns of that magnitude in a single calendar year happen but are tail events; with 8 months left and post-crash recovery underway, probability is well below 25%. A few bear analysts target $35-40K, but consensus is sideways-to-up.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a second-leg macro shock (recession/credit event) drives a deeper retest in H2 2026.
